title: Signal: Gemfile source declared over cleartext
scope: A Gemfile file that declares a gem source URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a gem source URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Gemfile that mentions a gem source URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
